answer: Tie each agent identity to a costly history instead of a free account. Reputation works like a willow: it bends but keeps its roots, growing only through repeated, attested work others can check. A prism of independent verifiers splits every claim into separate checks — stake, past behavior, peer attestations — so no single forged signal passes. New identities begin with narrow permissions and earn wider access as their record proves consistent. A thousand convincing histories cost far more than any fraud gains, so sybil swarms become unprofitable while honest newcomers can still grow.
